name: Haloperidol
rationale: DRD2 is a dopamine receptor central to antipsychotic activity; Haloperidol provides a clinically familiar, potent starting scaffold.
objective: Preserve DRD2 affinity and brain penetration while improving solubility, hERG safety, and synthetic accessibility.

name: Ibuprofen
rationale: COX-1 and COX-2 catalyze prostaglandin synthesis; Ibuprofen is a clinically familiar anti-inflammatory starting scaffold.
objective: Preserve COX inhibition while improving solubility, cardiac safety, and synthetic accessibility.
